replicated_originals.reference: Nelson, Adams & Salter (2013) The Marley hypothesis: Denial of racism reflects ignorance of history

A.reason: Bonam et al. (2018, Study 1) is cited as the second prior test of the Marley hypothesis (itself a replication of Nelson et al.) and used for context/sample-size and cultural-context comparison; all replication results, effect-size and CI comparisons are made against the 'original study' Nelson et al. (2013).

B.reason: Nelson et al. (2013) is explicitly the 'first or original study' on the Marley hypothesis; Studies 1 and 2 use its exact materials and analyses and compare group differences, historical-knowledge effects and the mediation against its results (failure to replicate).

notes: Borderline on A: the General Discussion says 'we attempted to replicate prior research on the Marley hypothesis (Bonam et al., 2018, study 1; Nelson et al., 2013)', but Bonam's Study 1 is itself a replication of Nelson's finding and no replication result is benchmarked against Bonam's statistics, so the finding replicated is Nelson et al.'s.
